routes.name: Full three-point verification by localized theorem of sums

C9000377.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 377 (Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ regularity for infinity-harmonic functions.; papers: Uniform Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_377.statement: The manuscript's dimension-dependent interior C^{1,alpha} gradient estimate holds for every bounded infinity-harmonic function in dimension d >= 3.

C_TP_377.statement: Proposition prop:three-point holds over every nonzero endpoint separation in every finite dimension.

C_TP_QUANT_377.statement: For every n >= 1, infinity-harmonic U on B1 with Lipschitz bound L >= 0 and affine error epsilon has normalized midpoint defect at most min(L,4096 L^(6/7) epsilon^(1/7)) over every pair of distinct endpoints in B1/4.

C_TP_LOCALIZATION_377.statement: A violating pair yields an interior positive maximum with r -> 0 and |h| <= 2 C r^2.

C_TP_SUMS_377.statement: Original CIL Theorem 3.2 applies to U_i,U_i,-2U_i and forces D^2 Psi[sigma] >= 0.

C_TP_CONTRACTION_377.statement: The full Hessian contraction has a negative r^(-1/2) term and a uniform bounded remainder, independently of endpoint-to-affine-error scale ratio.

C_BLOWUPS_377.statement: Every locally uniform infinitesimal blow-up at a fixed center of an infinity-harmonic function is linear.

C_FAMILY_FLATNESS_377.statement: The normalized family cylinder-flatness modulus tends uniformly to zero.

C_NONAFFINE_LIMIT_377.statement: Failure of every power rate produces a nonaffine entire viscosity solution with uniform sheared affine fits.

C_SCALE_SELECTION_377.statement: The failed-power-rate scale selection yields one failed parameter and uniformly successful enlarged fits nearby.

C_CYLINDER_COMPARISON_377.statement: Overlapping cylinder fits satisfy the stated angular and norm comparison bounds.

C_LIOUVILLE_377.statement: Every entire solution of D^2 v[(grad_x v,1)]=0 with the stated fits at every center and radius is affine.

C_FITTED_TOOLS_377.statement: The fitted limiting class has the frame covariance, normalized compactness, growth bounds, attained quadratic envelopes, and envelope-slope properties stated in Section 04.

C_ENVELOPE_CONTACT_377.statement: A nonaffine member of the fitted entire class yields an extremal pair v,W with a positive barycentric contact gap and matched finite limiting slope at (0,1), as in prop:envelope-contact.

C_DISCRETE_PROPAGATION_377.statement: The discrete envelope inequalities satisfy the stated drift, fitted-frame covariance, and logarithmic-velocity estimates used in contact propagation.

C_CONTACT_LOCALIZATION_377.statement: The extremal pair admits infinitely many contacts at dyadic positive times whose fitted frames contain a common terminal point with finite lower slope, as in prop:contact-propagation.

C_SLOPE_RIGIDITY_377.statement: A fitted entire solution with equal constant forward and backward envelope slopes at one point for every positive length is affine, as in lem:slope-rigidity.

C_POWER_DECAY_377.statement: The normalized family flatness modulus has a dimension-dependent positive power rate.

C_FITS_TO_GRADIENT_377.statement: Power-decaying fits yield existence and the claimed uniform Holder bound for the gradient.
